31 October 2026

MATHEMATICAL RESULT

algebra_compiler/MAIN_PROOF.txt contains the complete scoped theorem, ordinary
proof, construction of the learned centre, all-future positive trace guarantee,
joint confidence set, finite-bit corollary, full cost model, a cumulative exact
relation-learning extension, downstream objective transfer, and limitations.
Complementary reviews are retained. These are mathematical reviews and executable
checks, not a formal proof-assistant verification.

EXACT RATIONAL ACQUISITION

planning_agent/check_cyclic_exact.py: passed. Ambient dimension8, generated
algebra dimension5, learned cyclic dimension5, two generators and10 source
matvecs. It checks exact intertwining, faithfulness, metric selfadjointness,
and a later rational inverse expression. Distinct spectra are also displayed
numerically; the numerical display is not the source of the exact guarantee.

planning_agent/check_centre_exact.py: passed. Learns centre dimension2 and a
central minimal polynomial t^2-7t+10. It constructs central projectors at roots2
and5 and recovers (r,s)=(2,2),(1,1) from algebra and projector dimensions.
Projector identities, metric selfadjointness, one-copy traces and seed energies
are checked with rational arithmetic. This fixture has rational roots; the
general algebraic-root construction is proved but not implemented at scale.

algebra_compiler/cumulative_exact.py: passed. Ambient dimension4, final algebra
dimension8, five external admission requests, three essential generators,
24 product candidates =3*8, three witness vectors, metric rank8.
Source work is separated:188 acquisition source actions and48 independent
truth-check actions. Each residual execution is paid;24 is a candidate count.

algebra_compiler/check_regular_trace.py: passed. It converts an eight-dimensional
nonorthonormal concrete algebra model to a five-dimensional regular model,
using the physical G-adjoint to construct the positive regular metric. A later
noncommutative rational inverse expression has identical retained and direct
weighted trace10/3. Metric selfadjointness and expression reconstruction hold
exactly. Additional original source calls:0. This checks the optional established
regular-representation step; it does not supply a new acquisition assumption.
